map.竖曲线高程（本页代码口径，按页面 g₁/g₂/L 记号）：y=g₁×x+(g₂−: Vertical curve elevation (page code convention, using the page g₁/g₂/L notation): y=g₁×x+(g₂−g₁)÷(2L)×x² (x is the horizontal distance from the curve start, mathematically equivalent to the standard form y=y₀+i·x+x²÷(2R), with g₁ the initial grade i and (g₂−g₁)÷L corresponding to curvature 1÷R); linked values: tangent length T=L÷2, external distance E=L×|g₂−g₁|÷8.
